instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium full shot. In a bright indoor dance studio with white paneled walls and a window, the instructor in a black top and white tights (R1) and the young student in a black crop top and shorts (R2) sit side-by-side on a white wooden step. Both perform a leg stretch, holding their raised left foot with their hands while looking forward with focused expressions. Bright natural light streams from the window in the background, illuminating the clean white setting and creating a calm atmosphere.
